organization_name.title: Organization Name
organization_name.description: GitHub organization name (required for organization-related endpoints)

repository_owner.title: Repository Owner
repository_owner.description: Repository owner username or organization name (required for repository-specific endpoints)

issue_state.title: Issue State
issue_state.description: Filter issues by state (for repository_issues endpoint)

commits_since.title: Commits Since
commits_since.description: Only fetch commits after this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z). Leave empty for all commits (for repository_commits endpoint)
